gigTitle.text: I will build a **high-performance React** and **Nextjs website** with **TypeScript**

description.text: Build a **high-performance landing page** with **React/Next.js** and **TypeScript** for **instant loading**.
**Custom SaaS/Business site** with **Next.js**, **Redux**, and **GSAP** for **30% better engagement**.

descriptionInput.text: I will set up **automated deployment** using **Docker** and **GitHub Actions** to reduce **operational risk**.

briefDescription.text:
I am a **Senior Frontend Developer** and **Founder of Dev8X** with **6+ years** of engineering experience [1, 2].

I build **high-performance systems** that reduced code errors by **30%** through **TypeScript** adoption [2].

My work for **Total Health Dental Care** achieved a **40% reduction in load times** and processed **millions in payments** [3, 4].

I lead full-stack development for **TroopHunter**, delivering **instant-loading dashboards** using **Next.js** and **TurboRepo** [5-7].

For **Coral** and **Honeydu**, I utilized **GSAP** and **TailwindCSS** to boost mobile engagement and brand presence [8-10].

I focus on **US-quality engineering**, using **Docker**, **CI/CD**, and **clean code** to reduce your operational risk [11, 12].

I deliver **scalable architecture** designed for production-grade reliability and growth [12].

Let’s build a **reliable software solution** that drives measurable results for your business [12, 13].

milestones.description: Requirement analysis, project scoping, and selecting the optimal **tech stack** for scalability [14].
Architecting the system with **TurboRepo monorepo** and designing database schemas [14, 15].
Integrating **Node.js microservices**, **RESTful APIs**, and ensuring data optimization [11, 14, 17].
Deploying the production-ready system via **Docker** and **CI/CD pipelines** [13, 14].

fields.text: Why use TypeScript for my project?
**TypeScript** adoption reduces code errors by **30%**, ensuring a more reliable and maintainable code base [2].
How do you ensure my website is fast?
I achieved a **40% load time reduction** for major clients using **performance optimization** and **ImagesLoaded** [3, 4].
Can you build custom CRM or booking platforms?
Yes. I built a custom **CRM and Scheduler** for **15,000+ patients**, increasing re-appointments by **33%** [18, 19].
I manage everything from **Next.js frontends** to **Node.js backends** and **PostgreSQL** database design [5, 20].
What standards do you follow for code quality?
I use **ESLint**, **Prettier**, and **automated CI/CD** to maintain **US-quality engineering** standards [11, 12].

requirements.form_context: I collect these details to ensure your project follows production-grade standards, including **React/Next.js architecture**, **TypeScript** safety, and **high-performance** delivery [1-3].

fiverr_default_questions.question_text: If you're ordering for a business, what's your Industry?
Is this order part of a bigger project you're working on?

custom_question_builder.question_text: Please provide a detailed **Project Brief**. What are your main goals, and do you have a specific **tech stack** preference (e.g., **Next.js**, **React**, or **TypeScript**) [1, 3, 4]?
Do you have existing **Figma designs**, brand guidelines, or wireframes? Please attach them to ensure the **TailwindCSS** or **GSAP** implementation matches your vision [1, 5, 6].
Does your project require **Full-Stack ownership**, including **Node.js microservices**, **PostgreSQL** database design, or **Docker/CI/CD** pipeline setup [4, 7, 8]?
Are there specific third-party integrations needed, such as **Stripe/PayPal** for payments, **Agora** for video, or **Mapbox** for location services [5, 9, 10]?
What is your target for **performance optimization**? (e.g., achieving a specific load time or **40% faster performance**) [2, 11, 12].
